package.description: Lock keyboard and mouse input to allow for easy sanitization of the device

en-US.description: Lock keyboard and mouse input to allow for easy sanitization of the device
en-US.longDescription: Lenovo Quick Clean application allows healthcare professionals to lock keyboard and mouse input so the laptop keyboard can be wiped down to sanitize the device. The user can use the default 2 minute timer or specify an amount of time to lock out input. If the user finishes cleaning before the timer expires, pressing FN key plus Right Shift will exit the cleaning mode.
en-US.name: Lenovo Quick Clean

zh-CN.description: 锁定键盘和鼠标输入，以便轻松清洁设备
zh-CN.longDescription: Lenovo Quick Clean 应用程序可让医疗专业人员锁定键盘和鼠标输入，以便通过擦拭笔记本电脑键盘对设备进行消毒。用户可以使用默认的 2 分钟计时器，或指定锁定输入的时间。如果用户在计时结束前完成清洁，按下 FN 键加右 Shift 键即可退出清洁模式。
